A '''fan shot''' was a method of rapidly firing a blaster while swinging it in an arc, or "fanning" motion. If done well, several targets could be hit in rapid succession with this maneuver. [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]]-turned-[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] hero, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], was adept at firing his [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]] in this manner.<ref name="GH">{{SWGTCG|set=Galactic Hunters|cardname=Fan Shot}}</ref>

==History==
[[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] used this maneuver during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] when she and Han Solo were cornered by three [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] outside the [[Endor shield generator bunker]]. Organa produced a concealed [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], and swinging the blaster was able to eliminate the stormtroopers in a single moment.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Fan Shot was the name of a combat skill gained by smugglers in the game Star Wars Galaxies.
